scope: Refund SPI field definitions and business constraints.
precedence: SDK source defines fields, types and runtime behavior. requirement/format describe business constraints that adapters must validate for each scenario.

refundRequestId.description: Unique refund request ID generated by APO, correlating the refund request and enabling institution-side refund idempotency.
refundRequestId.note: Do not substitute the original payment request ID; this does not imply persistent platform idempotency.

paymentRequestId.description: Original payment request ID generated by APO, identifying the payment to refund.
paymentRequestId.note: Distinct from refundRequestId. Do not arbitrarily change the original payment identity during refund retries or inquiries.

paymentId.description: Unique payment acceptance ID returned after the institution accepted the original payment.

refundAmount.description: Amount to refund to the buyer for this request, from the institution's perspective.
refundAmount.note: Use Amount for currency and the amount in the smallest currency unit.

refundReason.description: Refund reason explaining the refund to the user or payment method.
refundReason.note: Up to 256 characters; the adapter must validate length. The SDK does not truncate automatically.

refundNotifyUrl.description: Address for receiving asynchronous refund result notifications.
refundNotifyUrl.note: Provide a valid address in the request. The platform provides neither Dashboard configuration fallback nor address-priority handling.

extendInfo.note: The field is String, not Map; both parties must agree on its contents.

result.description: Standard result for this call or refund notification, expressing status and error information.
result.note: Not an HTTP status; specific result codes follow platform mapping configuration.

refundId.description: Unique refund acceptance ID returned after the institution accepts the refund.
refundId.note: Maintain separately from refundRequestId; requiredness varies by method.

refundAmount.description: Amount to refund to the buyer for this request, from the institution's perspective.
refundAmount.note: Use Amount for currency and the amount in the smallest currency unit.

arn.description: Acquirer Reference Number supplied by the acquiring bank.
arn.note: Used to correlate the acquiring bank's refund reference record.

notes: Refund requests must carry refundRequestId, paymentRequestId, paymentId and refundAmount. Implement corresponding business validation in refund's anonymous ChannelApiExtension.

refundTime.note: Inquiry responses and notifications use ISO 8601. There is no promise of automatic timestamp generation or universal validation.

refundStatus.description: Refund business status: SUCCESS means refunded, PROCESSING means in progress, and FAIL means failed.
refundStatus.note: PROCESSING is not final. This field represents Antom-side refund status and does not prove receipt in the buyer's wallet. Map institution status according to the agreed contract; the String field is not automatically enum-validated by the SDK.
